caption_L2L3: Over the 10 year period from 2008 to 2015 sales of audio and visual equipment fell from £6 billion to only £4 billion, with the steepest fall being from  2012 to 2014, and a slight fall to 2015. There has been a slight bounce back since then, to £4.5 billion in 2018.
